entries.title: Bump h2 for RUSTSEC-2026-0258
entries.rationale: Accepted as a lockfile-only security remediation. Preserve the exact h2 0.4.16 checksum, verify the resolver rewrites contain no unintended new packages or wasmtime edge, and apply it before any release candidate is built.
entries.dependency_resolution: Run cargo-deny/advisory and lockfile diff checks against the Zion baseline; confirm all windows-sys rewrites are pre-existing package records.
security_reasons: changes the resolved transitive dependency graph across the workspace

tracking.implementation_plan: Implement only after dependency advisory verification, lockfile integrity checks, required Rust gates, Zion branding checks, compatibility checks, and CI review.

verification: Full-SHA lockfile diff, stated cargo-deny/build/unit validation, package/checksum changes, dependency impact, and compatibility surfaces reviewed; no source implementation made.
